Roll Call: Quirk test part 1.script: (function(){const S=["Izuku Midoriya", "Ochaco Uraraka", "Katsuki Bakugo", "Eijiro Kirishima", "Shoto Todoroki", "Tenya Iida", "Momo Yaoyorozu", "Kyoka Jiro", "Tsuyu Asui", "Fumikage Tokoyami"],L="U.A. Academy",A="Athletics Field";const QC=check({type:'quests-completed'})||[];if(QC.indexOf("The First-Day Quirk Assessment")>=0){skip=true;return;}for(const n of S){if(effects.length>=10)break;if(check({type:'npc-in-party',npc:n})===true)continue;const h=check({type:'npc-health',npc:n});if(typeof h==='number'&&h<=0)continue;if((check({type:'npc-location',npc:n})||'')===L&&(check({type:'npc-area',npc:n})||'')===A)continue;effects.push({type:'npc-placement',npc:n,operation:'moveTo',location:L,area:A});}if(!effects.length)skip=true;})();
